module: Node "Reload Vehicle" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tag reset). Reloads the vehicle (`veh:reload()`), i.e. a full reload of the vehicle object. Input pin: `vehId`. If `vehId` is not connected, the node takes the player vehicle (`getPlayerVehicle(0)`).
notes: Called every frame while the flow is active: connect it to a pulse to reload only once.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.
